response.overview: You can speak to someone at Princess Cruises by calling ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) (1-800-PRINCESS) in the U.S. or using their live chat option.  Phone & Chat Options  • U.S. Toll-Free Phone: Call ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) (or ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) for reservations, pre-cruise support, and general help. • International Phone Lines: Regional numbers are available for countries including the US (☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada)) and Australia (132488). • Live Chat & Online Forms: Visit Princess Cruises for live chat and support forms covering pre-cruise help, reimbursements, and Future Cruise Deposits. You can also use the Princess Cruises Contact Us page to submit an inquiry form,Call Princess Cruises directly at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) (1-800-PRINCESS) or use their online live chat for customer support. ⁠Princess Cruises support page allows you to access live chat, phone lines, and support forms for pre-cruise, post-cruise, and deposit inquiries.
